The '''Illodia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Illodia sector/Legends|Illodia sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] . The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Illodia]].
